bridge-type.label: Navimow Account
bridge-type.description: A Segway Navimow cloud account. Authorization happens through a browser-based login flow: once this bridge is created, check its status for a link to sign in.

parameter.name: pollingInterval
parameter.label: Polling Interval
parameter.description: How often, in seconds, to poll the cloud API for mower status.

thing-type.label: Navimow Mower
thing-type.description: A Navimow robotic lawn mower linked to a Navimow account.

parameter.name: id
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device id as reported by the cloud API. Normally filled in automatically by discovery.

channel-type.label: Activity
channel-type.description: The mower's current canonical activity, normalized from the cloud API's raw state.

channel-type.label: Control
channel-type.description: Sends a command to the mower.
